title: The merge tool keeps its record claim when a GitHub read times out
why: Owner, 15:10 CST Nov 7 (via the coordinator): a degen batch keeps failing to merge. Each GitHub check timeout made the merge tool undo its record claim, which moved the head and cost a new CI run.
note: In merge/merge.py, a GitHub read that cannot run (timeout, 5xx, connection error) after the claim push keeps the claim and stops with "unknown, rerun merge"; only a check that answered no reverts it (decision standing-merge-grant: only a proven refusal reverts the claim). Retry the read, and reuse the claim on a rerun. Topic merge-tool. Red test first. Built as #1695, with runner 8 (coordinator 19:08 CST).
